procedural_matters: 1) SUI 2022 represented by Alina Durrer. 2) Race committee represented by Elena Papazoglou. 3) Sebastian Beri was witness for Alina Durrer.
facts: In race 2 Girls Blue fleet Black Flag was displayed as the preparatory signal.
SUI 2022 was identified in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal.
A General Recall was signalled immediately after the start.
A board was already displayed on the Race Committee vessel, showing with 2 boats, who had been scored BFD from the previous Yellow fleet start. "Yellow Girls" was clearly displayed on the board.

SUI 2022 went to the Race Committee vessel, soon after the General Recall, and saw the "Yellow Girls" fleet list. At the same time other sailors were checking the board. SUI 2022 sailed away from the Race Committee vessel to the starting area with no communication with the SUI coach.
After SUI checked the board, the list of boats scored BFD, clearly marked as "Blue Girls" fleet. SUI 2022 sail number was displayed.
The board was displayed before the warning signal.
13 boats were on the list and 11 of those boats did not start.
SUI 2022 was scored DNE at race 2.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
